book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: بمحطة قطار زغيرة، بمكتب صغير، على طاولة، دفتر مربوط بسلسلة.
sentences.en: At a small railway station, in a small office, on a table, a book chained to the desk.
On it written: Complaints Book.

sentences.ar: والمفتاح عند ناظر المحطة، بس الدفتر مفتوح، وما حدا بيسكره.
sentences.en: And the key is with the stationmaster, but the book lies open, and no one closes it.
And this is what is written in it.
The first page:

sentences.ar: سيدي: بتجرب ياها، ممكن تكون كذبة.
sentences.en: Sir: trying it out, could be a lie.
Yfnkn wrote this.

sentences.ar: وتحتها، رسم وجه، بأنف طويل، وقرون، وتحته: إنت.
sentences.en: And beneath it, a drawing of a face, with a long nose, and horns, and under it: you.

sentences.ar: لما كنت مقترب من هالمحطة، طارت قبعتي من الشباك.
sentences.en: As I approached this station, my hat flew out of the window.
I.
Yarmonkin.

sentences.ar: مين كتب هاد، ما بعرف، بس أنا الأحمق اللي قراه.
sentences.en: Who wrote this, I do not know, but I am the fool who read it.

sentences.ar: لما كنت رايح لأداء واجبي، تعرضت لبصق من الطابق العلوي.
sentences.en: As I was going to fulfil my duties, I was spat upon from the upper floor.
Slovtsov, pupil.
Whoever wrote that is right.
Me too.

sentences.ar: كاتب المحطة، بتصرفه، ما بيسمح لمرتي ولا لبنتي ولا لي إنا نمرق من الرصيف بهدوء.
sentences.en: The station clerk, by his behaviour, does not let my wife or my daughter or me pass along the platform in peace.
A.
Z.

sentences.ar: أضيف إلى هذا الأساس، أن... وهنا مسحوا.
sentences.en: I add to the above that... and here it was rubbed out.
I know who wrote that.
It was Ivanov.
Ivanov, do not hide.

sentences.ar: بالانتظار أن يخرج القطار، قرأت هالجلسة اللطيفة بالانتظار.
sentences.en: Waiting for the train to leave, I read this pleasant sitting while waiting.

sentences.ar: من كتب هاد بيقول إنه إنسان مثقف.
sentences.en: Whoever wrote that says he is an educated man.

sentences.ar: تلاتة فقدت الصبر: ما تكتبوا شي ما إله علاقة.
sentences.en: Thirdly lost patience: do not write things that have nothing to do with anything.
Stationmaster.

sentences.ar: قبل يومين، أكلت بالمطعم فطيرة كانت... والباقي شتيمة، مسحوها.
sentences.en: Two days ago, I ate at the buffet a pie which was... and the rest an oath, rubbed out.
Dogs.

sentences.ar: كتب حدا، بخط كبير، بلا توقيع.
sentences.en: Someone wrote, in big letters, unsigned.

sentences.ar: يا صاحبي، اللي كتبت كلاب، أنا أعرفك، وأنت أعرف مني.
sentences.en: My friend, who wrote dogs, I know you, and you know me better.

sentences.ar: أنا أطلب من الجميع، أن لا يتناولوا في هذا الدفتر الشؤون الشخصية.
sentences.en: I request everyone not to discuss personal affairs in this book.
Stationmaster.
Nikandrov is a socialist!

sentences.ar: بينما كنت تحت تأثير انطباع ثقيل، أشعر بواجب الاعتراف: لقد تركت الدفتر، وبكيت.
sentences.en: While under a heavy impression, I feel obliged to confess: I left the book, and wept.
At life.
And whoever wrote that is an idiot.
Stationmaster.
The stationmaster himself is an idiot.

sentences.ar: وهذا بخط الناظر، لأنه بيكتب الحرف الأول هيك.
sentences.en: And this in the stationmaster's own hand, because he writes his first letter like that.
Kozmodemyansky, the gendarme, drinks.
And I have not drunk.
The gendarme.

sentences.ar: لا. الدركي شارب. وأنا شهدت. المفتش.
sentences.en: No. The gendarme was drunk. And I witnessed it. The inspector.
True, but you drank with him.
Stationmaster.
And since the key to the book is in my hand, I will lock it.
Stationmaster.
And beneath that, in another hand: he did not.

sentences.ar: وتحتها، بخط تالت: ولا رح يقفله.
sentences.en: And beneath that, in a third: nor will he.

sentences.ar: ولا حدا رح يقرا شي من هاد.
sentences.en: And no one will read any of this.
And that is the last page.
